subtask: Finite-precision and representation audit for compiling a common canonical EB comparator
status: succinct exact-descriptor interface and recursive sampler established; stochastic MW construction remains to be fully proved

claims.statement: For a fixed finite broadcast tree with K leaves, an individual pulled-back outcome effect is computed recursively by E_(a,b)=B*(E_a tensor E_b) using only d-by-d effects, in O(K) dense broadcaster-adjoint contractions.
assumptions: tree and local leaf effects are explicitly specified
B or B* is evaluable from a finite-bit dense descriptor
claims.limitations: Does not produce the exponentially long list of all tree effects.

claims.statement: The complete tree outcome z can be sampled under an input density sigma with probability Tr(E_z sigma) using a recursive left-marginal sampler and a d-by-d conditional right-root state chi=Tr_L[(E_a tensor I)B(sigma)]; at sigma=I/d the law is tau(E_z).
assumptions: the exact dense descriptor permits evaluating B(sigma), its marginal Phi(sigma), partial traces, and B* contractions
finite-precision sampling is allowed with inverse-polynomial total-variation error
claims.limitations: A device-only black box or arbitrary exact-real input does not give the same classical runtime guarantee.

claims.statement: For canonical effects E_z, with p_z=tau(E_z) and trace-one rho_z=E_z/Tr(E_z), the normalized-HS transfer map is d^2 E_p[|rho_z><rho_z|_tau]; on traceless space the sampled summand using rho_z-I/d has norm at most d and variance proxy at most dI.
claims.limitations: Using E_z/tau(E_z) as a state would be misnormalized by a factor d.

claims.statement: A common finite EB comparator can be represented operationally as a finite mixture of succinct tree protocols, even though its literal POVM list can have d^K outcomes. Equal-depth support responses can use any rank-at-most-n factorization Q=sum_i |A_i><A_i| and avoid the weighted construction's K^(-1/2) conditioning.
assumptions: the output format accepts a circuit/tree plus classical postprocessing
the dense broadcaster descriptor is finite-bit or available as an exact channel primitive
claims.limitations: No polynomial-size explicit POVM/effect list or dense final transfer matrix is provided.

claims.statement: A polynomial-precision stochastic matrix-MW compiler is plausible with rational finite-bit channel data and delta slack, but it requires an explicit stochastic regret/concentration proof; the existential compact-convex separation argument is not itself an algorithm.
assumptions: equal-depth support response from the internally audited tree proof
claims.status: algorithmic path identified; convergence lemma remains a required proof gate
claims.limitations: Exact polynomial output depends on defining the descriptor encoding, gate model, precision target, and whether a succinct protocol is acceptable.
